_comment: Reference values of the paper's runs. fig8: per workload the selected strategy (pick), the selectivity estimates the selection and the plan were built from, the number of matches and the paper's runtimes on Trino (native MR with the window on the gap variable, EIMER, GDYN = median of three runs). fig9: per workload the selected strategy and the selectivity estimates the selection and the plan were built from, and the number of matches per table (N, sigma, W). kleene: per workload of the query panel the selected strategy and the selectivity estimates. fig10: per workload the selected strategy, the selectivity estimates and the number of matches of the paper's run. realworld: per query (table, Q1..Q5 in the order of the paper's figure) the selected strategy (pick), the selectivity estimates on the 100,000-row table that the selection and the plan were built from, the number of matches at 100,000 rows (matches_verified_by_native_mr: whether native MATCH_RECOGNIZE finished in the paper's run and returned the same tuples), and gate_window = [first row, number of rows] of the small window of the table on which native MR and EIMER are compared on Trino.
